designs.name: 赤光·蜂冕
designs.design: Distinctive design: the upper and lower limbs are elegant cascading chains of hollow regular HEXAGON frames, about 9 per limb. Large open hexagons near the center shoulder overlap and progressively shrink toward the needle-like tips, each tilted a little farther to trace a continuous graceful crescent. Two narrow offset parallel rows of red hexagon frames form an airy architectural outer edge, linked by a very fine red spine. Do not make a straight honeycomb slab or random lattice. Broad strong shoulders, sharply tapered recurved ends, luxurious negative space. Central hexagram must remain the visual anchor.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium fantasy bow concept illustration for a Skyrim weapon mod. Create ONE spectacular, beautifully proportioned complete bow, isolated on a nearly black background, portrait composition with generous margins, full upper and lower tips and the entire taut bowstring visible. Near side view with just enough depth to read the geometry, bowstring on the right. Entire weapon is PURE RED self-luminous solid light, including the grip, limbs and thin bowstring. Use clean simple geometric primitives with very legible repeatable construction, exquisite rhythm of repeated forms bending smoothly into a recurved bow silhouette. Crisp bright red contours, darker saturated red faces where applicable, tasteful scarlet bloom; keep empty spaces truly empty. At the exact grip center is one hollow six-pointed star made of precisely TWO overlapping equilateral triangle outlines. All parts red, no black metal surfaces, silver, gold, white-hot core, blue or purple. No organic ornament, dragons, flames, ice, gems, writing, runes, complex engraving, industrial greebles, arrows, characters, labels, inset panels or watermark. Sophisticated geometric fantasy weapon design, not a schematic, not a generic modern compound bow.

designs.name: 赤光·方旋
designs.design: Distinctive design: limbs built entirely from a disciplined progression of hollow SQUARE frames, about 12 per limb, connected along a very fine red curved spine. The nested stepped squares gradually change orientation and size to describe a beautiful ribbon-like twisted arch, recognizable individual perfect squares in perspective, modest geometric depth. Broad layered square frames around each shoulder, sweeping into tightly stacked tiny squares at the recurved tips. No circles, no hexagons on the limbs, no solid plate surfaces. Both halves coordinated, graceful negative space and bold silhouette; avoid a straight stack or thick rectangular tube.

designs.name: 赤光·折曜
designs.design: Distinctive design: limbs are elegant serrated geometric wings made of paired long slender isosceles TRIANGLES and simple open V-shaped chevrons. About 10 precisely spaced modules per limb. Each module has one thin solid red triangular blade and one offset hollow triangle contour, aligned tangentially along a deeply curved recurved bow arc. Repeated blades sweep backward and progressively shrink toward the tips, forming a controlled geometric feather-like rhythm WITHOUT any organic feathers. Wide angular swept shoulders, very narrow waist at the central hexagram, sleek hooked tips. Only straight edged primitives compose the curves. Emphasize a fast aggressive silhouette different from a simple chain of equilateral triangle plates.
